anya: FYI  perf team saw a sporadic tail spike in staging overnight. We need a concrete MVP contingency: a traffic-split plan + pilot offer so sales doesn't stall. Quick round on options.

sam: what did perf show exactly?

maria: brief: during a 2h soak we saw intermittent p99 climbs (memory growth on the cache worker) triggered after sustained high-concurrency map/reduce jobs. Repro rate ~10%. Fix needs kernel-space patch + cache leak investigation (~7-10d).

kevin: so two practical paths: 1) keep schedule but ship a reduced runtime config + traffic-split by tenant cohort, 2) delay by 2 weeks to land full fix. Option 1 is viable if we enforce strong throttles and a simple degrade path.

lina: product: two pilot customers require SSO. If we trim SSO from MVP we must give them a pilot path and clear upgrade timeline. Sales prefers pilot over delay.

anya: propose traffic-split plan (draft):
```
- Phase 0: staging verification -> run 6h smoke with canary flag on
- Phase 1: 1% traffic to cohort A (non-enterprise) for 30m
- Phase 2: 3% -> 10% over 2h if health checks pass
- Phase 3: 25% after 4h if p95 < 850ms and p99 < 2s and error delta < 0.3%
- Cohort routing: route enterprise tenants to isolated pool with lower concurrency but higher cost (burst on dedicated GPUs)
```

kevin: add concrete runtime guards:
```
- Global per-tenant RPS cap = 180
- Embcache protective mode: switch to warm-only reads if memory grows > 70% of limit
- Auto-quarantine: any tenant with >30% of error volume => isolate and throttle to 20rps
- Canary rollback trigger: p95 > 1.1s for >5m OR error-rate delta > 0.6% -> immediate 100% rollback to stable pool
```

sam: I'll implement a feature flag that controls the embcache protective mode and the per-tenant caps. Also will add telemetry markers for cohort-id so we can slice metrics quickly.

maria: I'll own the staging leak detection run and a lightweight leak-mitigation that drops background map/reduce batching for embcache workers. That should reduce mem churn.

lina: comms plan: call it a "phased MVP with enterprise pilot". Offer the two SSO customers a paid pilot with manual SAML assist + guaranteed SLA for pilot. Include clear timeline: SSO landing in v1 (~2 weeks after GA).

anya: decision direction: proceed with Option 1 (ship on schedule with reduced runtime config + phased traffic split), trim automated tenant SSO from MVP but provide manual pilot, enable embcache protective mode flag, and apply the quarantine + rollback rules. Any objections?

sam: no objections. I'll target flag rollout and cohort tagging by EOD Wed.

maria: +1. I'll run extended staging soak and produce a mitigation checklist by Thu.

kevin: I'll produce the canary automation and the quarantine playbook. Ops runbook will have 1-click rollback commands.

lina: I'll draft pilot contract and customer note. Also update the product board to show a condensed SSO path for v1.

ops-bot: Release window unchanged. Canary automation ticket #7721 created and linked.

anya: action items:
- sam: feature flag + cohort telemetry tags  due Wed EOD
- maria: extended staging soak + leak mitigation checklist  due Thu EOD
- kevin: canary automation + quarantine + rollback playbook  due Tue noon
- lina: pilot comms + pilot contract draft  due Wed noon
- anya: update roadmap with trimmed-MVP card & owner links  due Fri

anya: we'll do a dry-run of the canary automation Thu morning. If staging soak still shows >5% repro, we re-evaluate for a 2-week slip. Thanks all :thumbsup:
